topic: 无本体ego-centric数据中手部检测精度对本体末端轨迹的影响

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: web-calibration dynamic expansion (high): Web calibration on 2026-09-11 identified the hand-detection-to-trajectory pipeline family: EgoVLA (arXiv:2507.12440, wrist/hand actions from ego video -> IK retargeting), EgoDex (Apple, 829h AVP device-tracked 3D hand), VideoManip (arXiv:2602.09013, 4D hand-object trajectory -> DP3 policy 62.86%), AoE (arXiv:2602.23893, HaWoR hand reconstruction pipeline), Video2Sim2Real (arXiv:2606.08828, HaMeR keypoints -> Mink retargeting), LUCID (embodiment-agnostic intent: object flow + palm pose), 3PoinTr (arXiv:2603.08485, 3D point tracks as embodiment-agnostic representation), MobileEgo Anywhere (arXiv:2605.05945). Retargeting-error analyses: mingrui-yu key-objectives retargeting study, Vision-Based Hand Shadowing (arXiv:2603.11383, failures stem exclusively from landmark detection issues), HumDex (arXiv:2603.12260), PKDA (arXiv:2511.10987). Device-tracked contrast family: FastUMI / ActiveUMI (arXiv:2510.01607) / UMI-3D / DexUMI. Prior run LR-EGO-HAND (20260729) quantified ego hand-tracking accuracy itself (in-domain MKPE 9-11mm -> 16.28mm in the wild); this run targets the downstream propagation into end-effector trajectory and policy success.

dynamic_suggestions.why: Core intersection: egocentric hand pose used for robot learning.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-ego-video-imitation-hand
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"egocentric video" AND all:"imitation learning" AND all:hand
dynamic_suggestions.why: Direct: imitation from egocentric human video via hand signals (EgoVLA/EgoMimic family).

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-hand-pose-retarget
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"hand pose" AND all:retargeting AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Direct: hand-pose-to-robot retargeting pipelines and their error behavior.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-human-video-wrist-trajectory
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"human video" AND all:"wrist trajectory" AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Direct: wrist/end-effector trajectory recovery from human video.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-egodex-egovla-titles
dynamic_suggestions.query: ti:EgoDex OR ti:EgoVLA OR ti:EgoMimic
dynamic_suggestions.why: Title anchors for the three flagship ego-video-to-robot systems.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-world-space-hand-recon
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"world-space" AND all:"hand" AND all:reconstruction AND all:egocentric
dynamic_suggestions.why: Method: world-space hand reconstruction (HaWoR family) as the ego-video action-labeling front end.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-hand-object-4d-policy
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"hand-object" AND all:trajectory AND all:policy AND all:video
dynamic_suggestions.why: Method: 4D hand-object trajectory reconstruction feeding manipulation policies (VideoManip).

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-embodiment-agnostic-rep
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"embodiment-agnostic" AND all:"human video"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Method: embodiment-agnostic intermediate representations that bypass or buffer hand-pose error (LUCID, 3PoinTr).

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-point-track-action
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"point tracks" AND all:robot AND all:manipulation
dynamic_suggestions.why: Method/alternative: point-track action representations that avoid explicit hand pose (ATM, Track2Act, 3PoinTr).

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-pose-noise-robust-policy
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:noisy AND all:demonstrations AND all:policy AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Limit: robustness of imitation policies to noisy action labels/trajectories.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-hand-tracking-noise
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"hand tracking" AND (all:noise OR all:error OR all:accuracy) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Limit: hand tracking noise/error/accuracy in robot data pipelines.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-label-noise-imitation
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"label noise" AND all:"imitation learning" AND all:manipulation
dynamic_suggestions.why: Limit: action-label noise in imitation learning for manipulation.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-hand-pose-benchmark-eval
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"hand pose estimation" AND all:benchmark AND all:egocentric
dynamic_suggestions.why: Eval: egocentric hand pose benchmarks/metrics (MPJPE/MKPE) that quantify the upstream error budget.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-retarget-eval-dexterous
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:retargeting AND all:evaluation AND all:"dexterous manipulation"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Eval: retargeting objective ablations and error metrics for dexterous manipulation (mingrui-yu study, PKDA).

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-human-video-success-rate
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"human videos" AND all:"success rate" AND all:robot AND all:manipulation
dynamic_suggestions.why: Eval: downstream policy success rates from human-video-derived trajectories.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-umi-tracking-deploy
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:UMI AND all:tracking AND all:manipulation
dynamic_suggestions.why: Deploy: device-based tracking (UMI/FastUMI/DexUMI) as the accuracy contrast to visual hand detection.
